messages:
maria: Heads-up — Tom from ArcoChip and I ran a quick joint perf/W sweep today. We found a weird regression at long seq lengths when using the new quant profile. Need to sync on kernel flags and launch timing.

ajay: thanks for flagging. can you paste the minimal repro and the perf delta?

maria: short summary: seq=1024, bsz=1, model=redwood-tiny-v2-quant, throughput down ~18% vs previous quant. power stable. suspect a kernel tiling mismatch.

lia-eng: ugh. that lines up with what we saw in nightly on the P-cores. cc @tom-partner — are you able to share the kernel build flags used on your side?

Tom-partner: sharing — we used ArcoChip stock driver + our tune layer. flags: 
```
KERNEL_TUNE=aggressive
L2_TILE=512
KV_CACHE_MODE=split
QUANTIZE_PROFILE=fastfp16
```
We also applied a micro-patch to GEMM that we can revert if helpful.

maria: thanks. on Redwood side we had L2_TILE=256 and KV_CACHE_MODE=combined. looks like mismatch. can we try L2_TILE=512 + combined to see if throughput recovers?

ajay: assigning quick experiment: lia to run 3 runs: (A) Arco flags, (B) Redwood flags, (C) both combined. log the power trace and perf counters. target today EOD. lia?

lia-eng: on it. will push script to shared bench repo and post link.

bench-bot: experiment run created -> https://bench.redwood.internal/runs/6187654321-01 (A/B/C runs queued) :bar_chart:

lia-eng: initial numbers in run 01: A=800 tok/s, B=960 tok/s, C=950 tok/s. so Redwood flags still win but Arco patch reduces latency tail. interesting.

Tom-partner: ok that helps. sounds like merge of L2_TILE+micro-patch could be our path forward. we'll open a joint PR and run compatibility smoke.

maria: next steps: 1) joint PR for unified kernel flags (owner: Tom) 2) SI handoff doc update for quant profiles (owner: Ajay) 3) canary plan for marketplace listing (owner: Maria). aim to freeze for partner announcement 2/3 weeks out. can we confirm owners?

ajay: confirmed on SI doc. I'll add checklist items (KPI: tok/s delta <5%, power delta <3%, tail-latency 95p within baseline).

Tom-partner: PR incoming by tomorrow. We'll also redact any IP-sensitive micro-patch details for public marketplace artifact.

lia-eng: once PR lands I'll queue a 24h soak on our Dedicated nodes and report telemetry.

maria: perfect. also quick note — marketing wants an embargoed one-pager for the joint announcement. I can draft, but need final perf numbers + acceptance from engineering before we give them anything. :white_check_mark:

Tom-partner: understood. we'll mark the PR "partner-ready" when tests pass.

ajay: blocker check: do we need FW updates on partner HW to get full perf? if yes, we should add to rollout timeline.

maria: good call — Tom, can you confirm whether the micro-patch is driver-only or requires FW?

Tom-partner: driver-only. no FW needed. that keeps timeline intact.

lia-eng: logging a mini-incident if perf dips during canary: https://incidents.redwood/internal/6187654321-canary (ops + bench alert).

maria: thanks. I'll sync with product on marketplace listing metadata (quant profile, supported configs, recommended batch sizes).

bench-bot: summary: action items -> PR (Tom), SI doc (Ajay), Canary soak (Lia), Marketing one-pager (Maria). ETA checkpoint in 48h. :eyes:

maria: cool. ping me in thread with any blocking test results. thanks everyone. :pray:
